description: Enter password values only through the owner-authenticated portal password form; MCP refuses raw password arguments. These legacy schema fields document the underlying operation, not permission to send secrets through MCP. DESTRUCTIVE: wipe and reinstall a Proxmox VPS from an OS template — ALL DATA ON THE VPS IS ERASED. Pick template_id via impreza_vps_list_templates and set a new root password (min 8 chars). Requires the "manage" scope; always confirm with the customer before calling. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.
name: impreza_vps_reinstall
title: Reinstall VPS
